meta.note: Official names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is written in this entry's own words from the cited sources; no guide text is copied from another guide. Early unlock rates are day-1 data from Exophase (19 Nov 2026, small sample), shown for rarity context only.

trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of everything else: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no shortcut and no multiplayer requirement — the whole list is single-player, offline, and finishable in one playthrough of about 200 hours. Work the roadmap in order and the platinum lands right after A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1–5) and collect the 12 automatic story trophies.
Clear the side characters, strangers, activities and collectibles in stages 3–5 of the roadmap.
Complete the 100% checklist to earn A Long Road — the platinum follows immediately.

trophies.guide: This is the story's finish line: it pops when the final main mission is done, so you cannot miss it. The last mission is 'Starting From Zero' at the end of Chapter 4 — play through the story and it comes to you. Note that the game has no mission replay and no New Game+, so enjoy the run; the trophy itself needs nothing extra.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the main story through Chapter 4.
Complete the final main mission, 'Starting From Zero'.
The trophy unlocks automatically at the mission's end.

trophies.guide: The 100% checklist is the real endgame: it appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done, and anything you did during the story already counts toward it. The good news is that nothing on the checklist is missable, and the requirements are forgiving — closer to 60% true completion than a full one. The full checklist is in the roadmap (stage 6); work it after the story in free-roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Work the checklist in stage 6 of the roadmap: 100 optional missions, 200 scanned vehicles, 100 studied animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 target decks, 15 of 18 meditations.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist hits 100% — the platinum follows.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the game's 397 stunts will do: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 passes under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 parachute base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one. Under-the-bridge passes are the quickest to farm; track your progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts (R3 for progress by region), and find stunt spots on the map under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Open Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see found and completed stunts by name.
Farm Under the Bridges first — they are the quickest of the four kinds.
Mix in stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps until the counter hits 250 (300 for 100%).

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges across Leonida and 42 gold medals to earn — one gold in every challenge at every range. The ranges are the same places that raise your Focus level, so the practice pays twice. The cited guide lists every range location; work range by range and the silver pops with the last gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find the 12 shooting range locations (see the cited guide for the map).
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges — one per range discipline.
The trophy unlocks with the final gold medal.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger questlines count — and several familiar faces do not. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are side characters, not strangers for this trophy. The confirmed counting strands are Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile deliveries); more strangers were still being discovered as of 19 Nov, so check the cited guide for the current list. All of it is available after the story in free-roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish Kirk's strand: search for the Skunk Ape, find the tree effigies, then help Kirk find Mr. Mangrove.
Finish Kyle's strand at McKittrick Farm, Yago's race strand, and Pilot Pete's delivery strand.
Complete any 8 counting stranger strands — the trophy pops with the eighth.

trophies.guide: Complete any three collectible card sets. The card sets tie into Bret's questline and the 100% checklist (15 target decks), so this one progresses naturally while you hunt cards across Leonida. Any three finished sets count — you don't need them all.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards while exploring — card sets are found across the state.
Complete any three full sets (the 15 target decks feed the 100% checklist too).
The trophy pops with the third completed set.

trophies.guide: The WAiNK app on your phone is the scanner: hold Up to open it instantly, hold R1 to scan. Use it at 100 different locations and the silver is yours. You'll be scanning constantly for vehicles and the Randy wish list anyway, so this one fills up on its own if you scan everything you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app with Up, then hold R1 to scan at each new location.
Scan at 100 different locations — vehicles, landmarks, anything scannable.
The trophy pops at location 100.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, robbed and escaped. The first one is taught by the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)': tail a security van to a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase in, and go in once the vault opens — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag, because you can't carry it all. After that, pay the fence Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icon; finish his earlier quests first, including robbing two Payday Loans). Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level instantly, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. Eight large bank jobs exist and each can pay up to $205,000 — the best endgame money in the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' to learn the first vault robbery.
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier quests).
Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs and escape each 4-star wanted level — fast bike first, then switch vehicles.

trophies.guide: The very first main mission, 'Gone Fishing', in Chapter 1. It pops the moment the mission ends — just play the story. This is the trophy almost every player earns first, and it marks the start of the 60–80 hour story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start the story and play the first main mission, 'Gone Fishing'.
Complete the mission — the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: Chapter 1 done. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2 ('What's in the Bag?'), so just keep playing — the trophy is automatic and cannot be missed. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one missable step for Positive Mental Attitude (see its guide) before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through Chapter 1's main missions.
Start the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?' — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Chapter 2 done. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3 ('Welcome to Vice City'). Chapter 2 is also the turning point where character switching opens up (after 'Coffee Break'), unlocking the side characters, the partner mechanics and most of the activities in this guide.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through Chapter 2's main missions.
Start the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City' — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Chapter 3 done. It unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 ('Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'). By now the map is open and most systems — fences, jewelry jobs, the key cloner — are unlocked, so the free-roam grind can start alongside the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through Chapter 3's main missions.
Complete the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life' — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Chapter 4 done. It unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero' — the same mission that earns the gold 'You Gotta Know When to Get Off'. Chapter 4 holds most of the big set-piece missions (the cartel heist, the VCIA takedown), so this trophy lands near the story's climax.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through Chapter 4's main missions.
Complete the final main mission, 'Starting From Zero' — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 2 main mission. 'Breakfast Run' is part of the story's natural flow — play it and the trophy pops at the end. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the Chapter 2 main mission 'Breakfast Run'.
Complete the mission — the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 main mission. 'The Cartel Heist' is one of the story's big set pieces — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. It is automatic, so the only job is to enjoy the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach the Chapter 3 main mission 'The Cartel Heist'.
Complete the mission — the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 main mission. 'Child's Play' plays out as part of the story — finish it and the trophy pops. Automatic, no preparation needed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the Chapter 4 main mission 'Child's Play'.
Complete the mission — the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 main mission. 'Headliners' is part of the late-story run — finish it and the trophy pops. Automatic, like every other story mission trophy.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the Chapter 4 main mission 'Headliners'.
Complete the mission — the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 main mission at the airport. 'VCIA Takedown' plays out as part of the story — finish it and the trophy pops. Automatic, no extra steps.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the Chapter 4 main mission 'VCIA Takedown'.
Complete the mission — the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: A Chapter 5 main mission. 'Operation Savage Glory' is the story's last stretch — finish it and the trophy pops. Like the other mission trophies it is automatic; the only requirement is playing the story through Chapter 5.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the Chapter 5 main mission 'Operation Savage Glory'.
Complete the mission — the trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 in Belville: a call from Andy, then a text with her address marks the start. Five quests in all — climbing the Cellerica chain, paying the Cellerica fee, the initiation, retrieving the Cellerica van, and the warehouse meet. It stays available after the story, so there is no rush, but it is Lucia-only, so switch to her for it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: As Lucia in Chapter 3, wait for Andy's call, then follow the text with her address in Belville.
Work the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the van), Puff Puff Pass (warehouse meet).
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is a treasure diver in Key Lento (green 'KR' icon) from Chapter 1: after the main mission 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' he calls, and the treasure-diving quests begin. Seven shipwrecks in total, marked by purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive with a metal detector, dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 (as Jason he texts; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up). Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: After Chapter 1's 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)', take Kenton's call and start the treasure-diving quests.
Dive all 7 shipwrecks: follow the purple treasure-chest map icons, use the metal detector, dig the treasure up and return it.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's quests open after the Chapter 2 main mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the whole strand stays available after the story. Straightforward: take each quest as it appears and the trophy follows the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work Billy's five quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's 'Wish List' opens after the Chapter 3 main mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)' — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars and delivers the first car, the Zorrusso. Sixteen cars are wanted in total, from the Vitello and Infernus to the Banshee and Baller ST-D. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City); scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list. The cars are common in east Vice City, Vice Beach and Ocean Beach — parked outside hotels or driving around — and delivering one in good condition pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' to unlock the Key Cloner and deliver the Zorrusso.
Steal and deliver the 16 wanted cars (check the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; scan cars with WAiNK first).
Deliver the last wanted car — the trophy pops with the final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 3 after 'Here, Kitty Kitty': destroy the Synthetic Labs in 'Take Out Kitty Litter', then finish with 'Spin On This'. Short and direct — two steps and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: As Jason in Chapter 3, after 'Here, Kitty Kitty', take Tyrone's call.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs ('Take Out Kitty Litter'), then complete 'Spin On This'.
The trophy pops with the final mission.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', out in Lummox County. You'll need the unique rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' from Ammu-Nation for the hunt. The strand also feeds the 100% checklist: 15 target decks are part of it, so this trophy and the checklist progress together.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: As Jason after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', meet Bret in Lummox County.
Buy the unique rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' from Ammu-Nation.
Work Bret's hunting questline and hunt the unique animal — the trophy pops with the final hunt.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — read this one carefully. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with BOTH Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The final meditation needs both characters playable together (after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'). Why it may be missable: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — after the mission 'Down to Earth', Lucia talks about meditating in the morning and goes to the balcony. Follow her and choose 'Accept'. It raises the counter by 1 but is NOT marked as a 'Meditation Spot', so whether it is required is still unconfirmed (the cited guide's author had done it when earning the trophy). Do it to be safe — it costs a minute and may save the platinum.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, after 'Down to Earth', follow Lucia to the balcony when she talks about meditating and choose 'Accept' — do this even though it isn't marked as a spot.
After Chapter 2 'Coffee Break', visit all 18 meditation spots (10 locations) with BOTH characters — each spot counts +2 that way.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the trophy pops at the last spot.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one try each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check the list under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most are introduced by the story; the rest are marked when you unfog the map (filter Map > Activities, the blue dumbbell icon). It comes automatically while doing the other trophies — don't grind it, just check the list at the end and fill the gaps.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you have tried.
Try each type once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win, and a stunt.
The trophy pops when all 9 types are checked.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen locations, 42 drone races in total — win one at every location. Drone races are their own activity type (they also count toward Master of None), and winning at all 14 spots is what this trophy wants. Work location by location; the races are short, so the grind is repetition rather than difficulty.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations (marked on the map once unfogged).
Win a drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races exist in total).
The trophy pops with the win at the last location.

trophies.guide: Forty unique race locations exist; win at 20 different ones. Each location only counts once, so you need breadth, not repeats — twenty different wins. Races also feed Master of None, so this trophy pairs naturally with the activity checklist.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Find race locations on the map (40 unique spots).
Win races at 20 different locations — a repeat win at the same spot doesn't count.
The trophy pops at the 20th different win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)', Cal texts you a fishing location (purple map icon) — follow his fishing questline from there. This is the most commonly earned non-prologue trophy on day one, which tells you how early and easy it is: meet Cal, fish where he points you, and beat him at his own challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)'.
Follow Cal's text to the fishing location (purple map icon) and work his questline.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Four arcade games exist in the game ('Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind (playable at the home TV) and Bang For Your Buck (arcade machines). Complete ALL levels of one game — you don't need to beat all the challenges, and you don't need to finish all four. Pick whichever you like best and see it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
Play through ALL levels of that one game (challenges optional).
The trophy pops when the last level is complete.

trophies.guide: Fifty of the game's 80 challenges (70 are needed for 100%, so this one is a milestone on the way, not the end). Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and more — they accumulate passively while you play, so check the counter late and mop up the easy ones you skipped. No single challenge is required; any 50 will do.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Play normally — challenges complete passively across combat, driving and exploration.
Check your challenge count and pick off the easy ones you haven't done.
The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges (70 for 100%).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' (character switching), call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), get a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and the bank vault robberies, which all trigger 4-star heat — so you may earn it without trying.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Chapter 2 'Coffee Break', call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Lose the cops — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) is the easiest escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After 'Coffee Break', call your partner the same way, then rob three shops in a row while KEEPING the flashing wanted level — armour vests, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline help. The best spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'): rob a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. If it doesn't pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Chapter 2 'Coffee Break', call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Rob three shops in a row without losing the flashing wanted level — the three jewelry stores in north Vice City work best.
Wait ~30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it hasn't popped, rob a fourth.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple focus bar (top-left, under health and stamina). You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in ONE use — and one use lasts only seconds. Buff focus first (food and drinks, wash your face or shower at home), consume Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, then Triangle), line up five enemies (gang operations are ideal), wear body armour and use an assault rifle (the Duke 556 is accurate and full-auto). It does NOT work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, purple eye icon); raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. It gets easier late-game and often pops naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Raise your Focus level first (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) and buff focus with food and drinks.
Find five enemies grouped together (a gang operation works well) and wear body armour.
Trigger Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming), use Adrenaline to extend it, and take down 5 enemies in that one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a LARGE passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — not the planes on the airfield; it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and the stairs by the boarding bridge lead straight in (or walk in through the terminal). Inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is delayed, so keep flying.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the large passenger plane at terminals E3/E4 (drive through a fence, or walk in through the terminal).
Board via the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit.
Drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away — the trophy pops (delayed).

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until it pops. The hard part is getting in — once you're in the tank, the trophy is quick.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island (Mariana County).
Enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance and climb into a Rhino tank.
Shoot enemies from the tank until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silently lockpicks alarmed doors; it stays in your inventory permanently, no equip needed) and jewelry store robberies (green icons in unfogged map areas). Break in through the BACK door with the Snap Gun — the prompt offers kick-the-door (alarm) or Snap Gun (stealth), so pick the Snap Gun. Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies.
Enter a jewelry store through the BACK door using the Snap Gun (not the kick — that trips the alarm).
Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe and leave undetected.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': robbing the large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck — tail the truck to the bank, the guard carries cash to the vault, enter and steal it, then escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. The earlier method also works: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it up and escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Play the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — the vault robbery counts as the truck robbery.
Alternatively, block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, and escape the heat radius.
The trophy pops once you escape.

trophies.guide: 557 vehicles exist at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes) — you only need to discover 100. Easiest by far: the WAiNK app (hold Up to open, hold R1 to scan). Stand on a busy road and scan passing vehicles; scanning is enough, you don't need to drive them. Two hundred of the 277 base-model vehicles are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. Track it under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles (totals per category).
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app (Up), then hold R1 to scan vehicles.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — 100 discoveries is the target.
Track progress under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map (the starter guide counts 52 areas). Fastest with a plane: fly over every black-fog area until the map is fully visible. It pairs with the story — by the time you've driven across the state for missions and side quests, most of the fog is already gone; the plane run finishes the rest.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Explore as you play — missions and side quests clear most of the fog naturally.
Take a plane and fly over every remaining black-fog area until the map is fully visible.
The trophy pops when the whole map is unfogged (52 areas).

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, 39 illegal gang operations — rob one operation belonging to each gang (all 39 for 100%). Operations are marked by yellow icons when you go near them, and many are auto-marked from story progress. Track it under Progress > Gangs (per-gang count, bottom right). One per gang is enough for the trophy; the full set is a 100% job.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Watch for yellow icons as you travel — they mark nearby illegal gang operations.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs (track under Progress > Gangs).
The trophy pops with the ninth gang's operation.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED (as of 19 Nov 2026) — the cited guide lists this trophy as currently unknown, and no reliable guide has published how it unlocks. The description itself points to having a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but that is only what the name and description suggest — treat any method you see online as unverified until the cited source confirms it. Check the source link below for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: No confirmed method exists yet — check the cited source for updates.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED (as of 19 Nov 2026) — the cited guide lists this trophy as currently unknown, and no reliable guide has published how it unlocks. The description suggests smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but that is only what the description says — treat any method you see online as unverified until the cited source confirms it. Check the source link below for updates.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: No confirmed method exists yet — check the cited source for updates.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling (a gang operation in Port Gellhorn): buy Sticky Bombs first at Ammu-Nation — you'll need them to blow the safe. The robbery is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. The three valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office, golden icon), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' (table, north-east corner, golden icon), and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with Sticky Bombs). The trophy pops after you ESCAPE the police. Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long time — go back for the remaining valuables; they don't all have to be stolen in one go.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Buy Sticky Bombs at Ammu-Nation first.

During the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling', steal all three valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun (north-east table), and the safe (north-east hallway office, blown with Sticky Bombs).
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.guide: Have MAXIMUM strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, the heart icon). Only after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' (character switching). Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness-club membership (filter Map > Activities, the dumbbell icon; clubs are all across Vice City) — and ALWAYS go together with your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one works out, the other completes their training automatically, doubling progress. Home workouts also work after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Chapter 2 'Coffee Break', buy a fitness-club membership (Map > Activities, dumbbell icon).
Always work out WITH your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them) — the partner trains automatically, doubling progress.
Reach maximum strength with both characters at the same time — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile (PlayStation tracks a count to 500 — click the trophy in the trophy list to see it). Turn on notifications first: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On (a demon face appears at the right of the screen when an action counts). Profiles: Professional (stealth objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating, limb shots), Violent (killing enemies/civilians), Psycho (killing many cops/civilians, driving over gravestones), Irredeemable (permanent if you keep using excessive violence). It comes passively while doing the other trophies; if you're short at the end, farm it by running over civilians or cops — but note that at Psycho/Irredeemable, cops shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so counted actions show on screen.
Play normally — profile actions accumulate across stealth, combat and driving.
If short at the end, farm the remaining actions; the trophy pops at 500.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is a TOTAL, cumulative — not at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (after Chapter 4 'That's Where The Money Is…'), so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then launder the marked bills at a fence (Yasmani pays best).
Reach $250,000 laundered in total — the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 total across all shop types; fastest on guns, car mods and tattoos (the most expensive things). The shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. It fills up on its own if you buy gear as you go — check the counter late and top up with a big purchase if you're short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear as you play — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest spend.
Spend across any shop types; the total is cumulative.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: Eight purchasable garages (plus 4 story garages; only the 8 purchasable count), total $160,000. They become available after the Chapter 2 main mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)' — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone; buy through the app. The money comes from robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)' to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app ($160,000 total).
The trophy pops with the eighth purchase.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 main mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)': it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garages first (Little Boxes — each garage adds parking spots). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click 'Respray' then 'Register'. Initially he only accepts vehicles WITHOUT trackers; later (Chapter 3) you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep it low.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)' to install the Scooter Bros app.
Own enough garages first (Little Boxes) for parking spots.
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click 'Respray' then 'Register' — use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost low.
